fields.statement: Verified at ecec6df5. A build of this commit's rhiza ran `workflow check ship-change`: valid. `workflow describe ship-change` shows conflict-triage-landed on.fail -> rebase-merge-gate-failed, whose on.fail -> landed-infra-triage (rhiza ship check --infra), whose on.pass -> landed-infra-wait (until rhiza ship check --settled --changed --rerun-infra, 6h, 30s, max_visits 3), whose on.pass -> landed-green (max_visits 4). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes, and TestShipChangeLocalGate pins landed-green's cap at 4 (>= 1 + the wait's cap). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-(landed-)?infra-wait' passes both scripts. GOTMPDIR was moved to the scratchpad and RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN were unset, because the run's GOTMPDIR under the repo's .git makes rhiza init find the real repo. run-ship-landed-infra-wait drives a landed run through landed-green fail, conflict-triage-landed, rebase-merge-gate-failed, landed-infra-triage and landed-infra-wait, then landed-green visit 2 pass, gate-rebase-merge, rebase-merge, wait-rebased-merge, rebased-merge-green, merge, wait-main, main-green and close-out. It asserts the wait's own `run rerun 42 --failed` follows a --rerun-infra poll and comes before a `pr merge 7 --squash --match-head-commit <landed head>`, and that the branch is removed. The model's landed nodes ship-change-ci-fix-step and ship-change-conflict-fix-step now describe the post-land infra wait, and ship-change-landed-infra-wait supersedes both. Nit, not part of the acceptance: the comment above [step.conflict-triage-landed] (ship-change.toml:271) still says a red CI 'still ends the run there'.
